name: – After § 4 – Am 15
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text: 4a. Recognises that the current crisis results from a combination of internal and external factors, including structural weaknesses in economic and democratic governance, delayed reforms and policy failures, as well as the increasingly negative impact of the US embargo, extraterritorial sanctions and energy blockade imposed in January 2026;
